purpose: Preservar el contexto acumulado sobre observacion fisica de archivos MAK y sus consumidores, separando arquitectura portable de casos locales.

scope.archive_inputs: explicit roots supplied to the observer; read-only
scope.write_policy: only this session-learning directory is written by this record

operational_state.portable_claim: MAK puede observar un archivo fisico, materializar memoria append-only y producir proyecciones evidence-only sin convertir rutas, nombres o hashes en autoría, obra, proyecto, serie o publicabilidad.
operational_state.real_pilot_claim: El piloto ARICA/Fondart atraveso la cadena aceptada y produjo un dossier interno util con abstencion research-first; no produjo una postulacion lista ni una publicacion.
next_evidence_closure: validar la vigencia oficial de Fondart mediante el camino bounded de research
proyectar los witnesses tecnicos C04-C06 de ARICA al vocabulario de practice evidence
recalcular desde fit sin promocion ni mutacion del archivo

surfaces.physical_identity: artifact_id, physical_id y artifact_ref derivan de archive_id + relative_path; no derivan del contenido.
surfaces.content_identity: sha256 y content_id describen bytes cuando existen; null es valido para directorios, symlinks, errores y especiales.
observed_capabilities: conserva symlinks y fallos como artifacts
emite candidatos de exact_duplicate, numbered_sequence, sidecar_manifest y failure
calcula snapshot semantico sin root absoluto, hora de pared ni mtime_ns
reproduce el snapshot con el mismo archive_id y contenido relativo bajo otra raiz absoluta
serializa y deserializa JSON con rechazo de claves duplicadas
limits: no infiere obra, proyecto, serie, autoría, transformacion o publicabilidad
include/exclude filtran superficie, no crean semantica
max_files puede producir observacion limit_reached y una vista parcial
errores de lectura/hash no abortan el batch completo cuando son representables
failure_modes: symlink root rejected when not followed
hash/read/stat error represented as error artifact

surfaces.role: materializacion append-only y replay de snapshots
invariants: artifact identity is physical and archive-scoped
content_sha256/content_id are nullable byte observations, never identity
same bytes at two paths remain two physical artifacts
snapshots and artifact states are append-only
change_set remains diagnostic and is not a transformation fact
limits: does not rescan the source tree
database is an existing bounded storage surface, not a new archive ontology

surfaces.role: reconstruccion provisional sobre un indice SSD ya existente
surfaces.observed_boundary: Un indice de SSD es una observacion de fuente; no equivale a una carpeta montada ni a una obra confirmada.
non_portable_assumptions: project names or folder labels are not truth
SSD index metadata is not a native source witness
asset similarity is not authorship or series identity

surfaces.role: puente bounded desde reconstruccion hacia Project IR
outputs: one reviewable Project IR record per accepted reconstruction unit
invariants: library dependencies and shared resources remain relations/assets, not projects
inverse predicates are re-anchored when endpoint orientation changes

surfaces.role: unidad comun para Curatoria, Portfolio, Research y Postulacion
surfaces.truth_boundary: active/verified requieren evidencia y no son estados que el observador deba fabricar.
surfaces.consumer_policy: cada consumidor recibe el mismo registro evidence-bearing y conserva su propio gate; no hay silos de portfolio o application paralelos

surfaces.role: enlace entre Project IR aceptado y lado interno del artista
invariants: keeps duplicate physical refs even with equal content_id
does not infer authorship, artistic meaning or publishability
requirement_ids are copied only when explicitly declared
limits: does not turn research evidence into practice evidence without an explicit practice-scoped link

surfaces.role: representa requisitos documentales externos sin confundirlos con evidencia de practica
surfaces.observed_local_case: Fondart Nacional Linea Investigacion 2027; 38-page PDF, 22 constraints, 8 hard gates, 8 required documents; source validity remained observed_local/unconfirmed.
invariants: requirement-to-practice links require explicit requirement_ids or supports

surfaces.role: normaliza fuentes y claims de Research sin certificar practica
invariants: same domain/group does not count twice
limits: URLs/hashes prove capture integrity, not claim truth by themselves
a research result cannot become practice evidence without a future explicit scoped projection

surfaces.role: compila un dossier interno desde un plan y practice state comunes
invariants: rank orders selected programs but does not upgrade facts
private/raw paths and unlicensed content never enter public manifest
unit evidence refs may be candidate/observation refs and remain non-public provenance
limits: draft_only or blocked is not publication/submission readiness
research-first with ready=false may remain an internal omission, not a fabricated unit

surfaces.role: aprende solo de outcomes externos verificados y bindings integros
invariants: split by stable identity_group, never snapshot
no policy activation, model training, DB or mutation

pipeline.semantic_action: persist immutable snapshot and replayable physical state
bounded grouping with explicit alternatives and unknowns
derive multiple outputs without splitting authority

observed: valid Project IR and practice state
ARICA.Fondart_relation: local opportunity corpus is observed_local/unconfirmed; fit abstained and application remained blocked
technical_witnesses: C04 MP4/AEP evidence with output role unknown
C05 RAYU export witness supported for one export event
C06 one isolated EXPORTS_TO edge with three adversarial cases returning unknown

MYRA.classification: portability stress case for a different archive
MYRA.interpretation_limit: unassigned is an evidence partition, not artistic non-membership; candidate count and bounds affect coverage

RAYU.classification: ARICA subcase used for a real export witness
RAYU.supported_claim: one export event for the concrete GLB only

ISKVW.classification: portable reconciliation case across archive JSON and media tree
observed: numeric IDs extracted from medio.src, extra.fuente_original.ruta and fallback fields
cross-surface collisions reported rather than merged
invariants: archive and media are distinct surfaces
filename/ID join is a bounded reconciliation key, not work identity
read-only unless report output is explicitly supplied

evidence_classes.meaning: entrada, ruta relativa, bytes, metadata o error observado por el observer
relacion propuesta con score, evidence_for, evidence_against y missing_evidence
cadena explicita de fuente, accion, marcador, output y hashes
cannot_support: final delivery or authorship without separate evidence

evidence_classes.meaning: captura de fuente, hashes, licencia, source_group y claim extraction
resultado externo independiente con receipt/binding y hash valid

risks.description: fusionar por content_id destruye la distincion entre dos posiciones fisicas con bytes iguales
risks.control: artifact_id/physical_id/artifact_ref remain path-and-archive scoped; content_id is nullable metadata

risks.description: tratar carpeta, nombre, extension o secuencia como obra/proyecto
risks.control: candidate observations and evidence gaps; no semantic promotion

risks.description: confundir export observado con entrega final o publicacion
usar una copia local de convocatoria como current_verified
tratar observation/candidate refs como assets publicables
risks.control: preserve as non-public provenance; only physical artifact refs enter asset manifest

risks.description: usar snapshot, identidad o estado propio como label o dividir episodios del mismo grupo
hacer depender el archivo portable de Hub, DB, red o routers antiguos
risks.control: pure contracts first; optional consumers fail closed or bypass explicitly
